//: Copy this file to llm_devices.json in the same folder (it is gitignored). Only 'devices' is read; 'examples' is ignored, so a plain copy just gives you the local Ollama with nothing to misconfigure. To add a machine, move one entry from 'examples' into 'devices' and fill it in. 'This computer' is always offered and never needs an entry. See the README for what each field means.

examples.label: Remote Ollama (SSH tunnel)
examples.note: Preferred for a remote machine: the address and key come from your ~/.ssh/config entry, so nothing is stored here and the remote Ollama can stay bound to localhost.

examples.label: Remote Ollama (direct HTTP)
examples.note: Needs the remote Ollama bound beyond localhost (OLLAMA_HOST=0.0.0.0) and the port reachable.

examples.label: Hosted gateway
examples.note: Any OpenAI-compatible /v1 endpoint. api_key_env names the environment variable holding the key, never the key itself. extra_body carries anything non-standard the gateway needs; this one stops vLLM models reasoning before they answer.
